---
title: "METIS"
subtitle: "Configurable neural network surrogates for stochastic timeseries simulators"
toc: false
---

METIS is a collection of configurable "recipes" for training neural network
surrogate (emulator) models that stand in for expensive stochastic simulators.
Instead of running a slow simulator every time you need a sample, you train a
model once and then generate realisations cheaply.

The codebase favours simple, single-file implementations wired together with
[Hydra](https://hydra.cc) configuration, so that you can swap models, datasets
and training settings by editing YAML rather than code.

### Overview of METIS features
* Implementations of MLPs, Autoregressive Transformers, Flow Matching and Normalising Flows.
* Support for static parameter conditioning and sequence conditioning.
* Parquet-based dataloading pipeline.
* Weights and Biases integration for hyperparameter sweeping and experiment tracking.
* Visualisation utilities.

- **[Utilities and advanced features]()** — training on multiple GPUs and visualising datasets.
- **[Sweeping](sweeping/overview.qmd)** — tuning hyperparameters with Weights &

- **[SBI](sbi/overview.qmd)** — using a trained surrogate for simulation-based
  inference.
